training_target: Frozen G6B/G7-aligned 38D pre-action privileged physical state; supervision only, never a predictor input at evaluation

E1.input: Three 14D observations at decisions d-2,d-1,d plus two realized 2D actions at d-2,d-1
E1.temporal_state: fixed short history; no future action or observation

E2.input: Current 14D observation, posterior ten 2D-tracking velocities, log of ten posterior velocity variances
E2.estimator: 20D nonlinear tracking unscented Kalman filter with current-position measurement correction, followed by TRAIN-fitted 34-128-ReLU-128-ReLU-38 MLP mapper
E2.filter_process_state: Ten normalized 2D tracking positions plus ten per-control-step velocities
E2.initialization: Per-episode first tracking positions, zero velocity; covariance reset at each episode

risk_model_shared_inputs: Frozen 256D TD-MPC2 encoder latent of current observation plus each E0/E1/E2 38D estimated current physical state plus explicit Hx2 action sequence
mapper_selection: TRAIN optimization, VALIDATION checkpoint selection; DEVELOPMENT-TEST and untouched confirmation never used for fitting
